scope.description: One full snapshot at index 7 from an actually committed/applied leader prefix to a lagging voter with one earlier normal apply batch at index 5 outstanding. Explicit Campaign is observed before and after that apply response and after snapshot completion.
assumptions: Sequential RawNode API calls and per-target reliable FIFO processing.
MemoryStorage models completed storage in a crash-free schedule; actual application snapshot data is installed before attached completion is returned.
Fixed three voters after completed bootstrap, PreVote disabled, no ticks or external messages between Campaign and its immediate BasicStatus observation.
excluded: General consensus safety or liveness, client consequences and physical crash durability.
Old configuration batches, snapshot replacement, stale-term completion and restart.
A guarantee that every post-completion campaign must win.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: MemoryStorage models a no-crash stable-storage boundary.
Deterministic transport, a temporary follower partition and held local work replace production scheduling.
Public BasicStatus supplies the checked role and term; internal pending queues belong to the driver, not modified protocol internals.

plan_uncertainties: This checks a source-defined local admission responsibility, not overall election safety or client linearizability.
Only a single full snapshot, fixed membership and normal-entry older batch are covered.
MemoryStorage completion is not physical crash durability evidence.
